title: Correlators in the theory of Integral Discriminants
summary: Integral discriminants provide a simple and fundamental model for non-Gaussian integrals, associated with homogeneous polynomials of degree r in n variables. We argue that, in this context, the study of correlators is equally if not more important. In this paper, we study a natural class of correlators in this model -- the invariant correlators. We suggest a general method to compute invariant correlators using differential operators that act on the partition function.
